articles.title: Orcas Shatter Sunfish in Never-Before-Seen Cooperative Hunting Behavior
articles.summary: In the Gulf of California, orcas were filmed ramming a 2,000-kg sunfish at high speed, breaking it into thousands of fragments. This newly documented strategy may help juveniles feed or simply be play. Researchers call it a first in orca predation science.

articles.title: Supercooled Pig Kidneys Transplanted Successfully After 72 Hours in 'Landmark' Study
articles.summary: Using a pressure-controlled device, scientists stored pig kidneys at -4°C for up to three days without ice formation. Transplanted organs recovered faster than those kept on ice, a breakthrough that could extend organ preservation and ease the critical kidney shortage.

articles.title: Novel Helicobacter Strains Discovered in Elusive Pygmy Sperm Whales
articles.summary: For the first time, researchers identified three new Helicobacter genotypes in pygmy sperm whales, linking them to stomach ulcers and gastritis. The findings, from stranded whales, hint at undiscovered microbial diversity and potential health threats to vulnerable marine populations.
